title: Available and registered UK amateur radio callsigns (Ofcom FOI 01432624)
requestedAtNote: not held; the request thread is not recovered. The disclosure appears on Ofcom's FOI log with no requester or request date stated (the request necessarily predates the March 2022 response).
respondedAtNote: not stated in the held material; the response is filed under Ofcom's March 2022 disclosure log, and the worksheet's report-generation timestamp is 2022-03-14 (see dataVintage).
dataVintageNote: declared and well-supported. The single worksheet's name, 'Report1647268967067', embeds the report-generation instant as a Unix epoch in milliseconds (1647268967067 = 2022-03-14T14:42:47Z); Ofcom filed the disclosure under March 2022. This is one week later than the byte-identical-shaped ofcom-01420046 export (Report1646659776237 = 2022-03-07T13:29:36Z). The workbook is held from a single channel (the UK Government Web Archive capture), so the vintage rests on the embedded timestamp and the disclosure-log month, not on a two-witness byte agreement.

raw-extract-sheet-1-report1647268967067..contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the single sheet; header Value,Status,Type then 150,238 rows. Status vocabulary Allocated (98,575), Reserved (51,271), Available (380) and blank (12); Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row. Anomalies preserved verbatim: one Value is literally ',,' (two commas) carrying a Reserved status; 'G6 FMU' has an interior space; three Values carry a trailing non-breaking space (G0TQK, G7IWE, 2E1HON); two are lower-case (g0jrk, 2e1GTD); 480 four-character callsigns and 38 callsigns of eight or nine characters, most reciprocal 'M/…' forms including M/#PT2FM, M/#VK4VGK, M/#YO3IES and M/EI-8-DJ.

normalised--sheet-1-report1647268967067..contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class; 150,238 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning - no dates, not callsign-sorted). Status carried verbatim (Allocated/Reserved/Available and 12 blanks preserved); licence_class emitted empty (no class disclosed). The constant Type column is required-present but not carried. Three trailing non-breaking spaces were trimmed from callsigns (counted in the converter notes, never silent); the ',,' Value and the interior-space 'G6 FMU' are preserved verbatim. The ',,' callsign sorts first.
